title: Protect assigned numbers and disabled fields
goal: distinguishes the purpose of readonly controls and disabled controls.
summary: should still be submitted with the form, and the temporarily disabled off-campus notes should not be included in the form submission.
tasks: Set #record-id to read-only, retaining value A-031 and name="recordId".
disables #future, retaining its label and name.

example.note: You can use readonly on text controls and still submit their values. Disabled controls generally cannot receive focus and their values are omitted from submission.

hint: number and disabled for the disabled field. Both are boolean properties.
